skill.displayName: QR Code Generation And Recognition - 二维码生成识别

llm.summary: This QR-code skill is a straightforward JisuAPI integration, with external processing and API-key use that fit its stated purpose but deserve normal privacy caution.

dimensions.detail: Network transmission of QR text, image URLs, or base64 image data is expected for this API-backed skill, but users should understand that submitted QR contents leave the local environment.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Metadata declares python3 and the JISU_API_KEY environment variable; no package install hooks, remote code loading, or install-time mutation were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Invocation guidance is somewhat broad for QR API questions, but the artifact repeatedly identifies JisuAPI as the provider and does not include hidden role changes, prompt overrides, or unrelated agent instructions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, background workers, local file mutation, credential store access, or system-level changes were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The documented purpose is QR generation, QR recognition, and template lookup through JisuAPI; the Python code implements only those three commands against the declared Jisu QR endpoint.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending QR text, QR image URLs, base64 QR images, logo URLs, and your JisuAPI key to JisuAPI. Avoid using it for QR codes that may contain secrets, internal links, credentials, private customer data, or tokens unless that disclosure is acceptable; use a dedicated least-privileged API key and monitor quota usage.
llm.findings:
[TP2] expected: The mixed English and Chinese skill name appears to be bilingual labeling, not a spoofed tool name or visually deceptive identifier.
[LP3] expected: The skill does use an environment API key and network calls, but this is declared in metadata and is coherent with an external JisuAPI integration.
[SQP-1] expected: The trigger wording could be narrower, but it still centers on QR-code generation, recognition, and API use; no unrelated invocation path was found.
[SQP-2] expected: The lack of a prominent privacy warning is a documentation gap, but external processing is visible from the JisuAPI branding, endpoint examples, and implementation.
[E1] expected: External transmission to api.jisuapi.com is the core mechanism for the advertised QR-code API functions, not hidden exfiltration.
[SQP-3] expected: Chinese-language documentation matches the JisuAPI-focused presentation and is not a security concern by itself.
[T09] expected: The API key is sent as a GET query parameter, which can increase provider-side logging exposure, but it is used only for the intended JisuAPI requests and is not printed or sent to unrelated destinations.
